title: A user with only the View permission can open the Inactive tab
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 users (Admin, view-only user) · 2 browsers · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • User: [User-B] = a staff member whose custom role [Role-B] has only 'Part Library & Inventory → View' in the Parts department (no Create & Edit, no Delete).
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A] = tracked part set inactive by [Admin] in Setup.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Settings → Roles & Permissions, click "Create custom role", skip the template, name it (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL VIEWONLY"), turn on the Parts department and tick only 'Part Library & Inventory → View', click Save. [Role-B] = that role.
  2. Go to Settings → Staff, add a staff member (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST", last name "PL VIEWONLY") with an email address you can open, Role [Role-B]; save, open the invite email and set a password. [User-B] = that user.
  3. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL VIEWONLY PART), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-VIEWONLY-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  4. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-VIEWONLY-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL VIEWONLY PART).
  5. Set [Part-A] inactive: on the Active tab search [Part-A], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  6. Check the setup worked: in browser 2, signed in as [User-B], Parts → Inventory opens. If it does not open, re-check that View is ticked on [Role-B].
custom_steps:
1. In browser 2 (as [User-B]) go to Parts → Inventory.
  2. Click the Inactive tab.
  3. Search [Part-A].
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: The list opens on the Active tab, with the Inactive tab beside it.
  • Step 2: The Inactive tab opens.
  • Step 3: [Part-A] is listed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S9-N1, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas none (board 3.5 shows the Inactive tab as Admin). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
